test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held On: 27 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following indicators presents the picture of occupational structure and unemployment in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Labor force participation**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Labour force participation** presents the picture of occupational structure and unemployment in India.
 
• The **Labour Force Participation Rate (LFPR)** in India, as per data from the** Centre for Monitoring Indian Economy (CMIE)**, has dwindled to a mere 40%, dropping from an already meager** 47% in 2016**.
 
• This indicates that more than half of India's working-age population (15 years and above) is opting out of the workforce, and this trend seems to be escalating.
 
• LFPR essentially signifies the percentage of the working-age population seeking employment.
 
• The primary cause for India's low LFPR is the remarkably low participation of women in the workforce.
 
• As of December 2021, while the **male LFPR stood at 67.4%**, the **female LFPR **was alarmingly **low at 9.4%**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The **low LFPR** among women in India can be attributed **to various factors** related to working conditions, including inadequate law enforcement, inefficient public transportation, prevalence of violence against women, and societal norms that discourage women from seeking employment.
 
• These factors create an environment that is not conducive for women to enter the workforce.
 
• Furthermore, while the unemployment rate measures those actively seeking employment but unable to find it, it fails to account for individuals who have become discouraged and stopped looking for work altogether.
 
• This phenomenon often occurs when individuals of working age become disheartened by prolonged unemployment and lose hope in finding suitable employment opportunities.
